title: Positive signed degrees from a compatible algebraic-closure root tower
statement: Fix X, ell, W, compatible sections zeta_n and normalized module isomorphisms e_n as in lem-sp-qbar-root-basis. For every natural number d, the prescribed algebraic-closure twist in signed degree d+1 restricted to W is isomorphic to its degree-zero coefficient unit.

source.place: clause (3), positive tensor powers of the compatible root basis

proof.text: Obtain a natural isomorphism between the rational coefficient diagram and the rational twist diagram after restriction to W, with components linear over each finite coefficient field. This is the finite-stage compatibility step; it takes no field colimit.

source.place: clause (3), positive tensor powers of the compatible root basis

proof.text: Slice restriction preserves colimits: Over.forget W is left adjoint to the product functor and the induced continuous sheaf pushforwards are adjoint. Pull back the coefficient colimit cocone and the twist colimit cocone to the slice. Precompose the latter by the rational diagram isomorphism, and use uniqueness of colimits to identify their points. To prove linearity, precompose the two proposed action maps by the diagonal tensor of the coefficient colimit cocone with itself. Siftedness and preservation of colimits by tensor make this a colimit cocone. The resulting stage equations are exactly finite-stage linearity, the multiplication formula for coefficient inclusions, and the defining diagonal formula for the actual Qbar twist action. Reconstruct the sectionwise module isomorphism; its target is the regular coefficient unit.

source.place: clause (3), positive tensor powers of the compatible root basis

proof.text: Apply the existing linePowerOverUnit construction to the degree-one isomorphism. Its induction uses restriction of sheaf tensor products, tensor congruence and the unit isomorphism. Unfolding spSignedTwist in nonnegative degrees yields the asserted degree d+1 isomorphism.

theorem spQbarPositiveRootBasis
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (ℓ : X.residueField x)] (W : X.ProEt)
    (ζ : ∀ n : ℕ, (Scheme.purTwistRootsModule X ℓ n).val.obj (op W))
    (e : ∀ n : ℕ,
      (SheafOfModules.unit (Scheme.purTwistRing X (Scheme.purTwistFiniteRing X ℓ n))).over W ≅
        (Scheme.purTwistRootsModule X ℓ n).over W)
    (hζ : ∀ n : ℕ,
      (Scheme.proEtaleRootsOfUnityTransition X (ℓ ^ (n + 1)) (ℓ ^ (n + 2))
        (pow_pos (Fact.out : ℓ.Prime).pos _) (pow_pos (Fact.out : ℓ.Prime).pos _)
        (pow_dvd_pow ℓ (Nat.le_succ (n + 1)))).hom.app (op W) (ζ (n + 1)) = ζ n)
    (he : ∀ (n : ℕ) (V : (Over W)ᵒᵖ)
      (a : ((Scheme.purTwistRing X (Scheme.purTwistFiniteRing X ℓ n)).over W).obj.obj V),
      (e n).hom.val.app V a =
        a • (Scheme.purTwistRootsModule X ℓ n).val.map V.unop.hom.op (ζ n))
    (d : ℕ) :
    Nonempty ((spSignedTwist X _ (spQbarTwist X ℓ) (d + 1)).over W ≅
      (spSignedTwist X _ (spQbarTwist X ℓ) 0).over W)
